title: Italian Chicken Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Italian-inspired stir fry with chicken, made with a crispy roasted twist.
instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute, until fragrant.
3. Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
4. Add the roasted red peppers and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
5. Stir in the stir-fry sauce and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the chicken is coated.
6. Add the crispy prosciutto and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until crispy.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
